jobDetailAnalyses.scoreDescription: Calculated based on confirmed required and preferred skill requirements.
jobDetailAnalyses.scoreDisclaimer: The match score does not represent the probability of being hired or prove actual proficiency.
jobDetailAnalyses.scoreDetails: Scoring Formula and Requirement Group Details
jobDetailAnalyses.scoreFormula: Skill Score = Required Coverage × 80 + Preferred Coverage × 20, rounded to the nearest integer.
jobDetailAnalyses.scoreRules: AND requirements are scored as individual skills, while OR requirements are treated as a single alternative group. Duplicate requirements are removed. The 80/20 weighting is an initial setting and is not claimed to be optimal.
jobDetailAnalyses.snapshotDetails: Job / Profile Snapshots and Original Job Description
jobDetailAnalyses.historyDisclaimer: Analysis history is read-only. Changes to the Job or Profile will not affect this result. Running a new analysis creates a new record.
